```{=html}
<style>
/* the sound-design lessons: widgets are made by apps/shared/lessons/synth-kit.js from <div class="sk" data-w="..."> */
.sk-w{border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:10px;background:var(--site-surface);padding:.8rem 1rem 1rem;margin:1.1rem 0 1.6rem}
.sk-w.sk-live{border-color:var(--site-accent)}
.sk-w.sk-target{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--site-accent) inset}
.sk-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.5rem .8rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.sk-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.05rem}
.sk-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.4rem .6rem;margin-left:auto}
.sk-tools .sk-c{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;min-width:0}
.sk-w .btn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.78rem}
.sk-w .btn.sk-on,#sk-bar .btn.sk-on{background:var(--site-accent-dk);border-color:var(--site-accent-dk);color:#fff}
.sk-status{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.sk-ctls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(11.5rem,1fr));gap:.45rem 1rem;margin:.3rem 0 .6rem}
.sk-c{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:.8rem;margin:0}
.sk-c .sk-cl{color:var(--site-ink-2);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.sk-c output{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink);order:2}
.sk-c input[type=range]{order:3;width:100%;accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk)}
.sk-knob{display:none}
.sk-knobs .sk-ctls{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(5.6rem,1fr))}
.sk-knobs .sk-ctls .sk-c:not(.sk-s){align-items:center;text-align:center}
.sk-knobs .sk-c:not(.sk-s) input[type=range]{display:none}
.sk-knobs .sk-c .sk-knob{display:block;order:2;width:3.4rem;height:3.4rem;cursor:ns-resize;touch-action:none;border-radius:50%;outline:none}
.sk-knobs .sk-c .sk-knob:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--site-accent)}
.sk-knobs .sk-c output{order:3}
.sk-knob svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.sk-knob .sk-kt{fill:none;stroke:var(--site-border);stroke-width:3.5;stroke-linecap:round}
.sk-knob .sk-kv{fill:none;stroke:var(--site-accent-dk);stroke-width:3.5;stroke-linecap:round}
.sk-knob .sk-kb{fill:var(--site-surface-2,var(--site-surface));stroke:var(--site-ink-3,var(--site-border));stroke-width:1}
.sk-knob .sk-kp{stroke:var(--site-ink);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round}
.sk-knobs fieldset.sk-group{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.3rem .8rem;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center}
.sk-knobs fieldset.sk-group>.sk-c:not(.sk-s){align-items:center;width:5.4rem}
.sk-c select{font-size:.85rem;padding:.1rem .3rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);color:var(--site-ink);max-width:100%}
.sk-group{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px dashed var(--site-border);padding-top:.35rem}
.sk-gl{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:.1rem}
.sk-presets{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;margin:.2rem 0 .6rem}
.sk-presets .sk-cl{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin-right:.2rem}
.sk-view{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.6fr;gap:.6rem;margin-top:.5rem}
.sk-view canvas,.sk-plot{width:100%;height:150px;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;background:var(--site-bg,transparent);display:block}
.sk-plot{margin:.4rem 0}
.sk-plot.sk-short{height:110px}
.sk-plot.sk-tall{height:230px}
.sk-plot.sk-square{height:240px;max-width:330px}
@media (max-width:640px){.sk-view{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sk-tools{margin-left:0}}
.sk-harm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(16,1fr);gap:2px;margin:.4rem 0;max-width:640px}
.sk-hcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.sk-hcol input{writing-mode:vertical-lr;direction:rtl;height:110px;width:22px;accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk)}
.sk-hn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:4px;background:var(--site-surface);color:var(--site-ink);padding:0 .2rem;min-width:1.5rem}
.sk-staff{margin:.4rem 0}
.sk-staff .abcjs-note,.sk-staff .abcjs-annotation{cursor:pointer}
.sk-info{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);min-height:1.4em}
.sk-tip{border-left:3px solid var(--site-accent);padding:.4rem .9rem;margin:.8rem 0;background:var(--site-surface);font-size:.95rem}
.sk-care{border-left:3px solid #d9822b;padding:.4rem .9rem;margin:.8rem 0;background:var(--site-surface);font-size:.95rem}
/* the tracker: a 64-row grid, one column a chip channel */
.sk-trk{position:relative;max-height:22rem;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;margin:.2rem 0 .6rem}
.sk-trk table{border-collapse:collapse;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem}
.sk-trk th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1;background:var(--site-surface);font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-2);text-align:left;padding:.2rem .4rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--site-border)}
.sk-trk td{padding:0 .2rem}
.sk-trk .sk-trk-n{color:var(--site-ink-2);padding:0 .5rem;text-align:right}
.sk-trk tr.sk-trk-beat td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-ink) 4%,transparent)}
.sk-trk tr.sk-trk-bar td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-ink) 9%,transparent)}
.sk-trk tr.sk-trk-now td{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--site-accent) 35%,transparent)}
.sk-trk input{font:inherit;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:var(--site-ink);padding:0 .2rem}
.sk-trk input:focus{border-color:var(--site-accent);outline:none;background:var(--site-surface)}
.sk-trk input::placeholder{color:var(--site-ink-2);opacity:.5}
.sk-trk input.sk-bad{border-color:#c0392b;color:#c0392b}
/* the bar at the foot of the window */
#sk-bar{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:1030;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.35rem .7rem;padding:.35rem 1rem;background:var(--site-surface);border-top:1px solid var(--site-border);box-shadow:0 -2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08);font-size:.8rem}
#sk-bar .btn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;padding:.1rem .45rem}
#sk-bar .sk-bl{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
#sk-bar input[type=range]{width:6rem;vertical-align:middle;accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk)}
#sk-bar .sk-tgt{flex:1 1 12rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
body.sk-has-bar{padding-bottom:4.5rem}
.sk-tune-read{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:.2rem 1rem;margin:.2rem 0 .4rem}
.sk-tune-note{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.8rem;min-width:3.4rem}
.sk-tune-cents{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:1.1rem}
.sk-tune-hz{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.sk-bb{margin:.4rem 0;overflow-x:auto}
.sk-bb svg{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;touch-action:none}
.sk-kbd[hidden]{display:none}
.sk-kbd{flex-basis:100%;display:flex;height:80px;position:relative;user-select:none;touch-action:none;max-width:760px}
.sk-key{flex:1;border:1px solid var(--site-border);background:#fff;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;font-size:.6rem;color:#666;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:0 0 2px}
.sk-key.sk-blk{background:#222;flex:.7;height:60%;margin:0 -1.1%;z-index:1;border-color:#000}
.sk-key.sk-down{background:var(--site-accent)}
</style>
<script src="/apps/shared/abcjs-basic.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/abc-transpose.js?v=4"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/lessons/sections.js?v=1"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/audio-check.js"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/pitch-detect.js?v=2"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/strobe-view.js?v=1"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/lessons/diagrams.js?v=5"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/lessons/synth-kit.js?v=11"></script>
```
